How to Build an Artificial Intelligence Revolution for All

The most important flashpoint in the debate over the future of artificial intelligence for both business and political leaders is: What is the impact of the technology on working Americans? Over the long term, AI’s promise will be measured not by the scale of its investment, disruption, or productivity, but by the apportionment across America of the value it creates.
